beats.headline: Bought with hunter hands
beats.text: Chaco the Bard runs the prize counter, and Carl has sixty-six hunter hands to spend. Among the twenty-hand items are spellbooks, wands and oddities: a drop shield, and a shrink wand like the one Zhang used to have, ten charges. Mordecai calls the wand a good choice too. Carl takes the shrink wand, the eighth-floor lore book, the sheet music for A Song of Skedaddle, a case of twenty-four Feather Fall potions and a case of healing potions. Everything bought arrives as a prize box, which can only be opened in a saferoom.

beats.headline: A collar, then a zap
beats.text: Carl has been saving the wand for armoured vehicles on the next floor, but the hydra's heads heal by breaking into pieces, and Carl is pretty sure the fire head is Bea's mom. The shrink wand cannot be used against living flesh. So he drives a snap collar, a frisbee of orcish steel, into her neck until it clicks shut, aims the wand at the collar with his left hand, and fires as a fireball forms in her mouth. The collar shrinks, the head flies away still screaming, and an achievement appears and goes.

beats.headline: Lent for a demolition
beats.text: Chris feels bad: the church across the way is pretty, and bringing it down will break the key. Carl tells him the real church is already gone, the key would only let one of them through, and the saferoom entrance can be protected if they do it right. Chris goes back to the church, where he, Zhang and several crawlers and strippers are to start a controlled demolition and build a channel underneath for the escape. Carl lends Zhang the shrink wand, since he has a lot of experience with that spell.

beats.headline: Two zaps, seven charges
beats.text: The Sheol fire finally starts to ease, and everywhere it touched there is nothing left. Chris and the others have been hard at work the whole time, making certain there is nothing directly above. Zhang messages that he only had to use two zaps on the wand, which leaves it with seven charges, and Carl also has a rare Wand Recharge scroll in his inventory if he ever runs out. Zhang returns the shrink wand as he and Chris go back to the saferoom.
